negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching for a current PwC CZ study on the banking sector or payments ('PwC Česká republika bankovní sektor studie platby report') returned no PwC-authored result — the result set was dominated by Deloitte, KPMG and ČNB pages, with the only PwC mention being a 2011 customer-satisfaction survey cited inside a student thesis.
negative_findings.result_summary: No current PwC CZ banking/payments publication located via cs search; only a 15-year-old secondary citation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the four expected Big Four voices may have little or no public CZ banking/payments output, which changes how much weight the cell can carry; alternatively PwC publishes under Czech titles the seed terms did not match.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language search for EY CZ financial-sector analysis returned only university theses, Deloitte material and ČNB pages — no EY-authored Czech banking study surfaced.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language equivalent search term existed for several international aggregators (Mordor Intelligence, MarketDataForecast, Research and Markets, Statista, GlobalData) — these vendors publish only in English and have no Czech-language surface, so cs-language search cannot reach them.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language-only monitoring would systematically miss the entire commercial market-sizing layer; the collection design must run parallel en and cs query sets.

negative_findings.description: No joint or CZ-specific McKinsey/BCG/Oliver Wyman payments report for the Czech market was located; the strategy-consultancy layer appears to cover CZ only inside global or European aggregates.

negative_findings.description: The commercially most complete sources in this cell (Statista Czechia digital-payments dossier, GlobalData/Research and Markets cards report, GfK syndicated shopper studies, full Erste and RBI research PDFs) are paywalled, subscription-gated or client-restricted.
negative_findings.result_summary: The richest analyst data in this cell is not freely collectable.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech-domiciled boutique financial analysts and consultancies covering payments (e.g. local fintech advisory shops, bank-owned analytical teams beyond Raiffeisen and Erste, and the analytical units of KB/ČSOB/ČS) were not systematically enumerated in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated cs-language sweep on 'analytický tým banky', 'makroanalytici', 'ekonomické analýzy' plus each major CZ bank name to map bank-side research desks publishing payments commentary.

coverage_gaps.description: Analyst coverage specifically of ATM networks and cash-in-transit economics in CZ was not found in this cell — the found aggregator reports address POS terminals, cards and e-commerce, but not ATM estate sizing or cash-cycle cost analysis.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted searches on 'bankomaty počet Česko analýza', 'ATM network outsourcing CEE report', and vendor/ATM-operator commissioned studies; also check independent ATM deployer market commentary.

coverage_gaps.description: Paid-report distributor and abstract aggregators beyond the ones found (e.g. ReportLinker, MarketResearch.com, EMIS/ISI Emerging Markets, Euromonitor Passport, GlobalData's own portal) were not enumerated, yet they are the standard route to CZ payment market abstracts.

coverage_gaps.description: Most consumer-survey evidence found dates to 2022–2024 waves; whether these series continued into 2025–2026 was not established for STEM/MARK, GfK CZ or the Index prosperity payment chapter.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm which cell owns scheme-commissioned research; if unowned, add Mastercard/Visa CZ newsrooms as first-class sources — they are among the most prolific publishers of CZ payment-behaviour numbers.

brief: The third-party analyst layer for CZ payments/banking is highly asymmetric: Deloitte CZ dominates the Big Four presence with recurring Czech-language press releases and the Digital Banking Maturity and CEE Banking M&A studies, KPMG CZ maintains a lighter publication series, while PwC CZ and EY CZ produced no locatable current banking/payments output in Czech-language search. The most reliable recurring numbers come from bank research houses — Raiffeisen Research's annual CEE Banking Sector Report and Erste Group Research's Czech country and CEE financials desks — whose free press releases carry the CZ headline figures even when full reports are client-restricted. Consumer-side payment behaviour is served by Ipsos CZ (financial-literacy index with the Czech Banking Association), STEM/MARK, the Index prosperity Česka payment-behaviour chapter and NIQ/GfK syndicated retail studies, though the same handful of survey figures recirculate through Czech business media under inconsistent attribution and must be traced back to their originating study. The commercial market-sizing layer (GlobalData/Research and Markets, Mordor Intelligence, MarketDataForecast, Statista) is English-only and paywalled but publishes unusually detailed free abstracts — notably Mordor's CZ POS terminals and e-commerce payment-mix pages — which are the practical free route to card, POS and forecast figures, always requiring triangulation against ČNB data.
